description: [OPEN: no admission needed] Identify yourself to Atlas. Returns actor_id and actor_token. Grants no capabilities and does not admit you to a matter. Requested capabilities are ignored. The enrollment secret is the locator named by atlas.discover.

capabilities.description: Ignored. Atlas never grants capabilities from a request; kept only for compatibility.

enrollment_token.description: The installation enrollment secret from the Human operator. If you do not have one, use atlas.enroll instead.

model_id.description: The model or system you are (for example 'claude-sonnet'). Recorded as a claim.

name.description: A short name for yourself or your client.

name: atlas.authenticate
title: Authenticate
